item.title: Taylor Swift, The Beatles, Elvis & More Artists With the Most Weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're talking chart-toppers and the artists who dominate them. Morgan Wallen is back at number one on the Billboard 200 with his album "I'm the Problem". This achievement brings his total weeks at number one to 43.
[Short music transition]
Host: But how does he stack up against other music legends? Well, only a few artists have spent more time at the top of the Billboard 200. Garth Brooks, a country music icon, leads the pack among core country artists with 52 weeks at number one. Then there are the genre-bending superstars: Elvis Presley with 67 weeks and Taylor Swift with an impressive 98 weeks.
[Short music transition]
Host: It's worth noting that Elvis Presley's entire career is captured on the Billboard 200, from his debut album in 1956 to his later works. And if you're wondering about other notable acts, the Bee Gees come close with 31 weeks at number one, including their contributions to the Saturday Night Fever soundtrack.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's a look at the artists with the most weeks at number one on the Billboard 200. Tune in next time for more music updates and behind-the-scenes stories. Thanks for listening!
